summary: Experts create data and practice environments to train AI models. AfterQuery also builds custom models and AI tools that carry out tasks for businesses.

featured_case.title: Inside NVIDIA’s office-task training
featured_case.description: NVIDIA used AfterQuery tasks to train models for office work. Model-generated action records supported initial student-model training and later training with rewards.
featured_case.qualifier: NVIDIA confirms task use. Payment and contract value are undisclosed.

products.name: Office Agent Training Dataset
products.description: Professional assignments based on files. Tasks require analysis across several steps, with graded outputs.

products.name: SWE agent training datasets
products.description: Experts write tasks from private business codebases. Automated tests check the results.

products.name: Terminal-agent training data
products.description: Successful action records from command-line tasks (text commands used to operate a computer). Tasks run in isolated environments and earn rewards from tests.

products.name: Customer-service tool-use data
products.description: Service tasks with several steps. Checks confirm whether calls to software tools work correctly.

products.name: Custom RL environments
products.description: Training tasks using connected software tools or browser and desktop applications. Expert action records and grading support reinforcement learning (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).

products.name: Expert demonstrations and feedback
products.description: Examples teach desired responses, with comparisons showing which answers experts prefer. Expert grading rules are paired with automated checks.

products.name: Enterprise model services
products.description: Identifies gaps in a model’s abilities and prepares training data. Further training adapts a specialist model or agent for deployment.

products.name: Atlas and Raine Search
products.description: Atlas helps label and organize data. Raine Search finds past deals using everyday-language queries. Deployed for a named client; general self-service availability is undisclosed.

relationships.name: NVIDIA
relationships.description: NVIDIA used AfterQuery tasks to train models for office work. Model-generated action records supported initial student-model training and later training with rewards.

relationships.name: Thinking Machines Lab
relationships.description: AfterQuery says it supplied training data for Inkling.

relationships.name: Thinking Machines Lab
relationships.description: AfterQuery used Tinker for further terminal-agent training and office-task distillation (training one model with outputs from another model).

relationships.name: Legora
relationships.description: Legora credits AfterQuery with co-creating a public synthetic BAR case. AfterQuery also reviewed how Legora prepared its data.

relationships.name: The Raine Group
relationships.description: An investor and Raine Search deployment partner. AfterQuery worked with Raine bankers to search past deals using Atlas and deal categories specific to the firm.

relationships.name: Motif Technologies
relationships.description: AfterQuery identifies itself as the sole data partner for Motif 3.

people.bio: Studied finance and statistics at Wharton, with computer science at Penn. His internships spanned finance and software engineering.
Previously founded an education-technology business that was acquired. His software-engineering internships included Citadel Securities and Google.
The launch describes his Wharton connection and an earlier startup with Spencer. Current title and employment status are unverified.

notes.text: Y Combinator’s current founder list names Spencer and Carlos. Launch material and the CEO’s account also name Danny Tang as an early team member. Danny’s current title and employment status are unverified.

operating_case.title: Legal evaluation with Legora
operating_case.description: Legora’s full evaluation set has 5,161 cases and 11,075 documents across 28 practice areas. BAR uses a subset of hundreds. One co-created synthetic case is public.

capital_note: The company says the round closed several months earlier. The exact closing date is undisclosed.
